description:
Born with incredible luck, Jeong-Yeon always has good things happening to him. Then, the most perfect-looking guy, Lee Yun-Seong, appears before him. Yun-Seong, who had always received attention for his good looks since birth, didn't like people who only approached him for his face. So, he wasn't thrilled when Jeong-Yeon expressed his interest right after meeting him.

 *"Can I call you hyung? Yun-Seong: “Heeeey~ I hope we see each other often from now on.”*

After their awkward first encounter, Yun-Seong gets annoyed whenever he keeps bumping into Jeong-Yeon wherever he goes. But Jeong-Yeon, completely unfazed by his irritation, keeps pestering him. Before he knows it, Yun-Seong finds himself quietly falling for him...

 *“Were you satisfied with my role as your living dildo last night?”*

The story of Jeong-Yeon and Yun-Seong, who bicker and clash every time they meet.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
